results.explanation: All 61 immutable supplied files verified; fresh 57 Python tests in normal/optimized modes and nine Rust tests in debug/optimized modes pass. Supplied source/foundation archives remain unchanged.
results.requirement: Verify bundled hashes and reproduce baseline, preserving immutable source.

results.explanation: Frozen repaired core v1, canonical typed IR verifier, checked intermediate ternary arithmetic, exact values and reference-equivalent first failure/effect order. Independent values and 84 fuel/depth parity points supplement differential checks.
results.requirement: Freeze language/IR semantics, ternary encoding, exact arithmetic, overflow, errors and effect ordering.

results.explanation: Context-owned immutable values and length-bearing strings; no C++ exception propagation across C ABI. Debug/O3 hostile witness/lifetime/allocation and typed external input tests pass. GMP system allocation exhaustion remains explicitly fail-stop.
results.requirement: Define ownership, numeric layout, runtime errors and native/JIT ABI.

results.explanation: Released LLVM 16.0.6 C API emits objects, links native GMP runtime and executes ORC machine-code addresses. C++/GMP runtime replaces the recommended Rust implementation language as a documented engineering choice. Compiler/JIT host uses Python; emitted AOT runtime does not.
results.requirement: Pin released backend and dependencies; prove object emission, runtime linking and minimal executable JIT spike.

results.explanation: Direct LLVM functions, branches, calls and recursion execute runtime helpers; changed bodies change output. Exact overloads and external runtime inputs execute generated native addresses.
results.requirement: Compile scalar bodies, branches, explicit overloads, calls and bounded recursion to executed machine code.

results.explanation: 1,979 runtime cases and seeded source corpus cover beyond-word integers/ratios, signed floor/remainder, invalid trit11, t32 bounds and intermediate overflow at O0/O2.
results.requirement: Preserve unbounded int/ratio and intermediate checked t32 arithmetic under optimization.

results.explanation: Exact ordered emits, first failure text and source location agree with reference and independent outcomes. Later effects are suppressed; resource/depth failures retain unlocated reference form.
results.requirement: Preserve source-located errors, assertion failures and ordered emits.

results.explanation: Five native examples plus three independently calculated runtime-input cases pass in an empty Bubblewrap root populated only by binaries and ELF dependencies, without Python or source files. Final compiler rebuilds all five isolated example binaries byte-for-byte.
results.requirement: Run compiled scalar/weight programs with no Python runtime dependency.

results.explanation: 47 source programs at two optimization levels pass AOT/reference/JIT equality, including seeded exact randomized arithmetic, boundaries, malformed IR and optimizer-hostile failures. Repaired development failures remain retained.
results.requirement: Exercise boundaries, generated cases, malformed IR and optimizer-hostile cases.

results.explanation: Native immutable trace/fusion/coupling records retain parents and canonical certificates. Independent forged digest/history/parent/scope/return/contact/replay cases reject invalid witnesses; canonical full-history comparisons pass.
results.requirement: Implement native immutable scoped traces and closure/fusion/coupling witnesses.

results.explanation: All five repaired examples execute in AOT and ORC with exact full observable output and canonical witness equality; all five also pass Python-free isolation.
results.requirement: Execute all five repaired examples natively with exact reference behavior.

results.explanation: Core v1 positive/negative syntax/type/runtime tests and explicit feature inventory pass. No grammar extension was required by the M0–M5 workloads. Structs, collections, loops, modules, I/O and pattern dispatch remain unsupported; original sketches are rejected. M6 needs separate increments.
results.requirement: Inventory supported syntax and add required grammar features in documented increments.

results.explanation: AOT and ORC share verified lowering, object emission and native C ABI. Generated addresses, direct user functions and both native entry paths execute and compare with reference.
results.requirement: Use verified lowering and common runtime ABI for AOT and JIT.

results.explanation: Source/ABI/compiler/runtime/CPU/features/target/options mutations invalidate cache identities. Corrupt objects, IR and manifests rebuild; tests cover three-process first builds, locked atomic publication, repeated unload, concurrent close and executable nonwritable mappings.
results.requirement: Validate JIT caching, invalidation, code lifetime and runtime symbol resolution.

results.explanation: Generated entry identity guard invokes separate O0 generic code on mismatch before source effects. Both paths execute and compare equal. Guard scope is whole-function identity; no input-range speculation or mid-function deoptimization is claimed.
results.requirement: Guard specializations at entry and invoke generic native fallback on guard failure.

results.explanation: Actual x86-64 hardware/OS/features/topology/affinity/load/memory and perf counter probe retained; unavailable counters are not zero.
results.requirement: Discover actual hardware capabilities and distinguish unavailable counters.

results.explanation: Protocol fixed before measurements: 3 warmups, 12 paired tuning, 20 paired held-out, fixed randomization, 2000-bootstrap uncertainty, 5% improvement/regression thresholds.
results.requirement: Declare workloads, warmup, paired/randomized order, sample counts, timing and uncertainty before measurements.

results.explanation: Seven actual AOT+ORC workloads retain build/link/load/profile/native-call/full-invocation/total costs, raw timestamped controls and reproducible analysis; final implementation hashes unchanged.
results.requirement: Measure compilation, profiling, loading, steady-state and total costs.

results.explanation: Exact source and main/generic/guard object hashes are prevalidated against reference and AOT output. Forced native guard failure executes generic path with equal observable results.
results.requirement: Allow learning to select only prevalidated semantically equivalent implementations.

results.explanation: Fresh subprocesses reload committed synthetic-fixture observations, revalidate exact native objects and actually dispatch optimized; absent state restores generic. Synthetic fixture establishes policy influence only. Separate real-measurement passive→active CLI reload passed and correctly retained generic.
results.requirement: Retain observations at k and demonstrate influence on execution selection at k+1.

results.explanation: All seven controls execute matching workloads/fresh contexts with exact semantic equality; 140 recorded control batches per workload. Frozen profile read-only, active updates after dispatch.
results.requirement: Compare generic, passive, frozen, active, stale/shuffled and state-removal controls.

results.explanation: No cost-inclusive benefit. Every workload restores generic. Later samples use doubled batches of the same programs; no unseen-program generalization. Concurrent compilation/conformance is a retained limitation.
results.requirement: Evaluate held-out results including overhead and regressions; preserve zero/negative gains.

results.explanation: Normal and optimized policy suites pass 12 tests each including restart, corruption, stale host/software/workload/artifact, version, invalid costs, state removal and interrupted temporary-file writes. Profile input/work/update costs bounded; single-writer ownership explicit. Checksum-valid unpaired counts or histories inconsistent with min(generation,32) reject; lawful capped paired histories load.
results.requirement: Invalidate incompatible profiles and keep correct generic fallback for corrupt or mismatched state.

results.explanation: Separate continuation not executed: no Dec-written frontend/lowering or seed→stage1→stage2→stage3 chain. Collections/modules/I/O remain future grammar increments. Legacy ELF demonstrations do not establish self-hosting.
results.requirement: Execute genuine Dec frontend/lowering bootstrap seed to stage1 to stage2 to stage3.

results.explanation: Detached patch cleanly replays onto pristine source; all 60 candidate source files match. Replayed compiler builds/runs ternary and reproduces the isolation-tested binary byte-for-byte.
results.requirement: Deliver candidate and detached patch with clean replay onto bundled source.

results.explanation: All 26 supplied criteria have explicit dispositions/evidence. Native compilation, JIT, persistent adaptation, no measured cost-inclusive benefit and unimplemented self-hosting are reported separately. Source, raw/failure evidence, replay and checksum manifests are delivered.
results.requirement: Report every criterion with evidence and separate compilation/JIT/learning/performance/self-host statuses.
